title: Loyal
detail: You've stood by me through every storm without ever asking for anything back.

title: Funny
detail: You have this rare talent of turning the dullest moment into something hilarious.

title: Kind
detail: Your kindness is the quiet kind — the kind that shows up when no one's watching.

title: Honest
detail: You tell me the truth even when it's hard, and that's rare and precious.

title: Supportive
detail: Every dream I've chased, you've cheered louder than anyone else.

title: Genuine
detail: There's not a fake bone in your body — what you see is exactly what you get.
